Thanks David. Alex — welcome, and thanks for sending the onboarding docs. A few notes on process from Procurement: 

1) Exception path: For pilot invoices <$2,500 we can use the invoice-only lane if the vendor is US-based and passes our vendor intake checks.
2) Required evidence: Completed PO_Exemption_Form.xlsx (attached), W-9 (attached), short SOW or invoice description, and a vendor primary contact.
3) Approval ladder: AE -> Procurement Manager (me) -> Finance approval for payment terms. If the paperwork is complete and vendor faces low risk, we usually approve within 3 business days.
4) Controls: Accounting coding must be provided on the exemption form so AP can post the invoice.

I attached the PO_Exemption_Form.xlsx and a short Risk_Checklist.pdf. Alex, please fill the exemption form and return; David, if you can confirm the exact dollar figure and billing entity, I'll kick off the intake.

One other caveat: if Noventon is working through a reseller or non-US entity for billing, we may need additional KYC and it will extend the timeline.

—Marissa
